title: Tackling Multimodal Learning Challenges with Mixture-of-Expert: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2605.27431v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) presents a naturally compatible and scalable framework for multimodal learning, demonstrating strong adaptability across diverse modalities and tasks. Despite its growing success, a comprehensive and systematic review on the MoE metho addressing multimodal challenges remains lacking. Existing surveys tend to evaluate either multimodal learning or MoE independently from method taxonomy, overlooking the unique interplay between them. translated_title: 用混合专家模型应对多模态学习挑战：综述
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型为多模态学习提供了一个天然契合且可扩展的框架，在多样的模态与任务中展现出强大的适应能力。尽管其不断取得成功，但目前仍缺乏针对解决多模态挑战的MoE方法的全面而系统的综述。现有综述往往将多模态学习或MoE从方法分类的角度独立评估，忽略了二者之间独特的相互作用。本综述通过回答一个核心问题来填补这一空白：MoE如何有效解决多模态挑战？我们从三个关键视角展开：(1) **MoE作为高效的多模态引擎**：通过将计算成本与参数增长解耦，并借助选择性专家激活缓解模态冗余，实现可扩展的多模态建模；(2) **MoE作为多模态表示学习器**：整合互补的多种……
tldr: 这是一篇系统梳理混合专家（MoE）方法如何解决多模态学习挑战的综述，从“高效多模态引擎”和“多模态表示学习器”等三个视角分析了MoE在可扩展建模与模态冗余缓解方面的独特价值。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews how Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) addresses multimodal learning challenges from three key perspectives, highlighting its role as an efficient multimodal engine and a multimodal representation learner.
